items.sentence: At the time of events giving rise to this complaint, Complainant worked as a Counseling Psychologist/Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist at the Agency’s Health Clinic in Baumholder, Germany. a) from [MASK] to the present time, management did not provide Complainant training, she was subjected to derogatory comments, unjustified interrogations and nitpicking her work, negative facial expressions, etc.

Consequently, when clients requested her by name, they were told they were not allowed to meet with her; c) on [MASK], in a staff meeting, the Captain made decisions about her clients without her input; d) on October 12, 2016, in a meeting with the Lieutenant Colonel 2 and Lieutenant 3, to discuss her request to be removed from the Baumholder Team, Complainant felt she was being attacked, as indicated through their tone of voice, which she considered to be disrespectful; e) on or about November 12, 2016, she was issued a performance evaluation which failed to accurately and truthfully characterize her work performance; f) upon returning to work on December 21, 2016, after being out sick on December 19-20, 2016, two clients were taken from her schedule and redirected to other providers; g) even though there is a shortage of providers in the office due to the holidays, the staff refused to engage her to help cover cases; The Lieutenant Colonel stated in his affidavit that he was the Deputy Chief of Clinical Services and the Chief Nursing Officer.

ROI2 at 96. h) the Non-Commissioned Officer-In-Charge (NCOIC) 4 brought a new staff member down and introduced him to all providers and staff in the office, but did not introduce him to Complainant even though they were talking right outside her office; i) in [MASK], she contacted Regional Health Command-Europe Inspector General (IG) about issues of discrimination and harassment.
On [MASK], she was contacted by the Sergeant First Class 5 regarding her complaint of discrimination and reprisal.
She informed the Sergeant First Class that Complainant’s legal counsel (Counsel) would be in Germany the week of [MASK], and she would like to coordinate a meeting.
